name: 便签
description: Markdown 桌面便签：多便签管理、实时预览、任务列表勾选、荧光笔高亮与回收站。Sticky notes with Markdown preview, task lists, text highlights and recycle bin.

en.name: Sticky Notes
en.description: Markdown desktop sticky notes with multiple-note management, live preview, task checkboxes, text highlights and a recycle bin.
en.safetyNotes: Note data stays in the plugin's own settings. The plugin does not access the workspace or make network requests; external links open in the system browser.

zh-CN.name: 便签
zh-CN.description: Markdown 桌面便签：多便签管理、实时预览、任务列表勾选、荧光笔高亮与回收站。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 便签数据仅保存在插件自己的 settings 中，不访问工作区或发起网络请求；点击便签内的外部链接会打开系统浏览器。

author: ZY

agentTools.name: list_notes
agentTools.description: List all sticky notes with title, snippet, color and timestamps; deleted notes are included only when includeDeleted is true.

agentTools.name: get_note
agentTools.description: Read one sticky note's full markdown content by id.

agentTools.name: search_notes
agentTools.description: Search sticky notes by title, snippet or content (case-insensitive substring).

agentTools.name: create_note
agentTools.description: Create a new sticky note with optional markdown content and color. The title is derived from the content's first heading or line.

agentTools.name: update_note
agentTools.description: Update a sticky note's content, color or mode. Content changes re-derive the title automatically.

agentTools.name: delete_note
agentTools.description: Move a sticky note to the recycle bin (soft delete; restorable via restore_note).

agentTools.name: restore_note
agentTools.description: Restore a soft-deleted sticky note from the recycle bin.

agentTools.name: purge_note
agentTools.description: Permanently delete a sticky note. This cannot be undone.

changelog: Release 0.1.3: migrates the panel to v3 paint-through chrome so top-band controls remain clickable without the legacy 46px blank area. Release 0.1.2: refreshes the sticky-notes panel chrome, controls, focus states, dialogs, and compact responsive spacing. Release 0.1.1: adapts the panel to PI-Desktop's cross-platform 46px host drag band and minimal three-button window-control capsule. First release: multiple notes, Markdown preview/editing, task lists, highlights, image paste, and recycle bin.
safetyNotes: 便签数据仅存于插件自己的 settings 中，不访问工作区或网络；点击便签内的外部链接会打开系统浏览器。
